decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Approve - Subject to the following condition:
Notwithstanding the approval of the siting and design aspects, no development shall take place until full details of all proposed external materials and finishes; and both hard and soft landscaping works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works have been carried out as approved. These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car park and pedestrian circulation layouts; hard surfacing materials, street furniture and lighting; and retained landscape features, where relevant)

Soft landscaping details shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, locations, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities; and an implementation / management programme.
description: Following outline approval for housing development 01137/E/P24 - partial details of reserved matters relating solely to residential development of Land Parcels C & D (Planning Brief) pursuant to Condition 1 and 2 (siting and design) of approved permission dated 04/11/1999.
